purpose: Stage and independently review only inert trusted-directory traversal and pinned regular-file binding primitives for future Local Mistral conversion evidence verification.
requiredInvariants: This PR is inert and stages only trusted-directory traversal plus pinned regular-file binding; it does not parse conversion-report JSON, verify content digests, authorize model/server semantics, invoke a model, publish evidence/status, or activate a workflow.
The conversion root is reconstructed only from exact lower-hex main SHA plus exact positive integer run id and attempt; the authority root must exactly equal the reconstructed literal.
Filesystem traversal starts from an open root directory FD and advances component-by-component with O_DIRECTORY, O_NOFOLLOW and O_CLOEXEC; fixed components are compile-time string literals.

Every directory FD in the chain, including filesystem root and evidence/artifacts/toolchain/bin parents, must be owned by root or the current effective service UID and must not be group-writable or world-writable; otherwise traversal fails closed before the next component is opened.
The only dynamic directory components are exact-main, which must match strict lower-hex SHA-40, and run-attempt, which is constructed internally only from exact positive integers.
The three admissible relative authority strings are exact literals for conversion report, Mistral GGUF and llama-server; they are equality checks only and are never passed to os.open.

Final filenames are compile-time literals opened relative to already anchored parent directory FDs with O_NOFOLLOW and O_CLOEXEC and must be regular files owned by root or the current effective service UID and not group-writable or world-writable.

Successful binding returns the same still-open pinned regular-file FD plus observed size, device, inode, owner UID and mode; later pathname replacement does not retarget that open FD. Callers must consume the returned FD rather than reopen the pathname.
All fail-closed ConversionEvidenceError raises suppress chained operating-system exception context and expose only fixed internal error codes.

Content hashing, sealed snapshots, conversion-report semantics, model identity and server binary identity are deliberately deferred to a later separately reviewed segment and are not claimed by this PR.
No product, API, database, RBAC, registration, cabinet, customer-data or production-routing behavior is activated.
Local Qwen is the independent reviewer because this changes future Local Mistral authority only.
REG.RU remains production authority and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
